cases.sql: CREATE TYPE read_enum_a AS ENUM ('first','last'); CREATE TYPE read_enum_b AS ENUM ('other'); CREATE TYPE read_enum_bad AS (a integer,b integer); CREATE VIEW read_enum_bad_value AS SELECT '(1,19)'::read_enum_bad AS v; CREATE TYPE read_enum_good AS (a read_enum_a,b integer); CREATE VIEW read_enum_good_value AS SELECT '(first,23)'::read_enum_good AS v
ALTER TYPE read_enum_bad ALTER ATTRIBUTE a TYPE read_enum_a; ALTER TYPE read_enum_good ALTER ATTRIBUTE a TYPE read_enum_b
SELECT (v).b,(v).a IS NULL,(v).a IS NOT NULL FROM read_enum_bad_value
SELECT CASE WHEN false THEN (v).a ELSE NULL END FROM read_enum_bad_value
ALTER TYPE read_enum_a RENAME VALUE 'first' TO 'renamed'
BEGIN; ALTER TYPE read_enum_bad ALTER ATTRIBUTE a TYPE integer; SELECT v FROM read_enum_bad_value; ROLLBACK
ALTER TYPE read_enum_a RENAME VALUE 'renamed' TO 'first'
DROP VIEW read_enum_bad_value,read_enum_good_value; DROP TYPE read_enum_bad,read_enum_good; DROP TYPE read_enum_a,read_enum_b
